name: Fortifications of Vauban
description: This network of 12 fortified sites lies along France's western, northern and eastern borders. All were designed by Sébastien Le Prestre de Vauban, military engineer to Louis XIV in the late 1600s. The sites include star-shaped citadels, sea forts, mountain forts and even whole towns he built from scratch, so you can trace his defensive genius from coast to Alpine ridge.
